testCases.name: test_answer_relevancy[What causes EB?]
testCases.actualOutput:
Epidermolysis Bullosa (EB) is primarily a genetic condition caused by a faulty or mutated gene. These genes are responsible for producing essential proteins that bind the skin layers together; when these proteins are missing or don't function correctly, the skin becomes fragile and blisters easily. This can be inherited from parents or occur due to a spontaneous gene mutation.

In rare cases, a severe form called Epidermolysis Bullosa Acquisita (EBA) can be acquired as an autoimmune disease, where the body's immune system mistakenly attacks its own healthy skin tissue. For more detailed information on the causes of EB, please visit the DEBRA UK website: https://www.debra.org.uk/get-support/eb-support-and-resources/epidermolysis-bullosa-eb/

testCases.name: test_answer_relevancy[What support does DEBRA provide for people living with EB?]
testCases.input: What support does DEBRA provide for people living with EB?
testCases.actualOutput:
DEBRA UK offers comprehensive support for individuals and families living with Epidermolysis Bullosa (EB) through its dedicated EB Community Support Team. This includes practical, financial, and emotional assistance, guidance, and advocacy to help navigate challenges related to medical care, education, work, and finances. We also facilitate access to specialist EB healthcare, provide financial grants for essential items and travel to appointments, and offer mental health support, including counselling and bereavement services. Additionally, DEBRA UK fosters community connection through events and subsidised holiday homes, and funds pioneering research to find effective treatments.

For more details on the support available, please visit:
*   **EB Community Support Team:** https://www.debra.org.uk/get-support/eb-support-and-resources/about-eb-debra-uk/eb-community-support-team/
*   **Accessing Specialist Care:** https://www.debra.org.uk/get-support/eb-support-and-resources/managing-medical-care/specialist-care-epidermolysis-bullosa/
*   **Benefits and Financial Support:** https://www.debra.org.uk/get-support/eb-support-and-resources/money-matters/eb-financial-support/
*   **DEBRA UK Support Grants:** https://www.debra.org.uk/get-support/eb-support-and-resources/money-matters/debra-uk-support-grants/
*   **Mental Health Support:** https://www.debra.org.uk/get-support/eb-support-and-resources/peer-support-events/togetherall/
*   **DEBRA Holiday Homes:** https://www.debra.org.uk/get-support/eb-support-and-resources/debra-holiday-homes/
*   **Member Events:** https://www.debra.org.uk/get-support/eb-support-and-resources/peer-support-events/member-events/
